4) Billing: Strong preference to honor proration to next invoice; where billing system limitations exist, offer a one-time credit instead. ProcureOps to confirm.
5) Security escrow: Acceptable with tightened notice timelines (from 30 to 20 days) and an audit-window carveout for critical incidents.

Action items: Laura — confirm tech ops feasibility and create migration checklist. Markus — if you agree, I’ll prepare counter-redline with tracked changes and a one-page cover memo for Thermionics procurement.
